propositions: Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional top-level imports of rebar_reconciler.git_adapter at _advisory_lock.py:83 and _ref_lock.py:194, breaking standalone by-path module loading which intentionally excludes the rebar_reconciler package.
The bridge-preview-under-contention test fails at _lock_remote when the module is loaded by file path without package context because find_spec("rebar_reconciler") returns None.

Both _advisory_lock and _ref_lock must use lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.git_adapter", "git_adapter.py") to converge on the canonical sys.modules key shared by package-context importers in _concurrency, reconcile_helpers, apply_outbound, and __main__.
The repaired seams must preserve adapter API identity, lock semantics, package-loaded behavior, and module patch visibility without expanding packaging or adding test-only path pollution.
